commentary.text: 90+13' Anthony Taylor is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+11' 3 - 1 Goal - 3:1! Fabio Vieira laid the ball off to Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
90+9' It is time for a substitution. Jorginho (Arsenal) is on for Martin Odegaard.
90+6' 2 - 1 Goal! Declan Rice (Arsenal) gets a shot away from inside the box and the effort is deflected past the goalkeeper. 2:1.
90+6' Arsenal have a corner.
90+4' 3:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
90' A substitution has been made. Gabriel Martinelli is replaced by Reiss Nelson (Arsenal).
90' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Manchester Utd due to an offside in the build-up play.
89' Celebrations by Manchester Utd are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
89' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) attempts to discuss the decision with Anthony Taylor, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
88' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) scores as he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a perfect strike that goes behind the goalkeeper.
87' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
86' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
85' The ball is cleared after Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Arsenal get a corner.
84' Erik ten Hag decides to make a substitution. Victor Lindelof will be replaced by Jonny Evans (Manchester United).
84' The game has come to an end for Antony. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United).
83' Arsenal hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
81' A pass into the box finds Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Andre Onana denies him.
79' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
77' The attendance is 60192.
77' That will be all from Kai Havertz who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Fabio Vieira (Arsenal).

76' The manager makes a subsitution with Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) coming on for Eddie Nketiah.
75' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Manchester Utd.

68' Good team movement sets up Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post.
68' Arsenal quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
67' Erik ten Hag is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) suffers an injury and Harry Maguire comes on.
67' It will be a substitution. Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) is ready to enter the pitch as Anthony Martial walks off.
65' Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Anthony Taylor had an easy-decision to make.

63' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) doesn't hesitate and begins a run towards the opponent's goal. Defenders try to tackle him, but he manages to keep the ball at his feet and pulls the trigger in front of the goal. The strike, though, was not as successful as the solo run and the ball is easily stopped by the keeper.
61' The Arsenal players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Anthony Taylor. NO PENALTY!
60' Celebrations by Arsenal are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
59' Poor challenge! Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United) is penalised for tripping and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle. It's a penalty to Arsenal! Let's see who's going to take it.
59' The free kick is taken by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal), but ball is cleared.
58' Anthony Taylor couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) and blew his whistle. Arsenal have a free kick.
57' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
57' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Arsenal are going to take it.
56' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
55' The resulting set piece from Manchester Utd is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
55' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. It will be a corner kick for Manchester Utd.
54' Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
53' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman signals a throw-in for Arsenal.
51' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

45+3' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal).
45+2' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) will deliver the corner kick.

45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

42' Aaron Ramsdale is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United). Easy save!

37' Manchester Utd are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
35' 46:54 – the ratio of ball possession.

31' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
28' 1 - 1 Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the bottom right corner.

27' 0 - 1 Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) scores a goal! He makes his way into the box without any help from his teammates and releases a shot that ends in the right side of the goal, bouncing in off the post.
25' Antony (Manchester United) tackles a bit over-zealously and Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
24' 5:0 – the total goal attempt statistics.

19' Declan Rice (Arsenal) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar.
19' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
18' An attempted cross from Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) is cleared. Arsenal force a corner. They send men into the box.
18' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
15' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) sends the corner into the box, but Andre Onana intercepts it and averts the threat.
15' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Arsenal.
14' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) takes the corner which is cleared.

14' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. The ball is out of play and Arsenal manage to earn a corner.
12' Gabriel (Arsenal) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
11' The Arsenal players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
9' Anthony Taylor has a clear sight and sees a foul from Kai Havertz (Arsenal).
8' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
6' A spell of possession for Manchester Utd in an attempt to control the game.
3' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
